title: Flex LogisticHub
tagline: Fluxstore customization for a logistics-oriented catalog and vendor workflow.
overview: Flex LogisticHub adapts Fluxstore Multi Vendor for a logistics/wholesale catalog — product grouping, vendor tools, and copy that match freight-style SKUs instead of fashion merchandising.
problem: A generic multi-vendor shop UI buried the fields logistics operators actually care about.
solution: Customize Fluxstore navigation, product cards, and vendor admin so catalog and order ops match a logistics hub, not a lifestyle boutique.
architecture: Same Fluxstore Flutter + WooCommerce pattern as the other Flex/Flux client apps, isolated in its own repo so brand rules stay separate.
features: Vendor tools carried from Fluxstore and trimmed to the hub's flow
Shared checkout backbone with client-specific theming
challenges: Reskinning a fashion-first template into something operators will trust
lessonsLearned: Information architecture changes beat color-only reskins for B2B catalogs
futureImprovements: Deeper shipping-rate surfaces if the merchant's Woo plugins expose them cleanly
results: A dedicated logistics storefront repo the client can keep evolving
